sponsored.t: Relates to the ability of the New York state medical care facilities finance agency to issue certain bonds and notes
sponsored.ls: New York State Medical Care Facilities Finance Agency Act
sponsored.sum: Increases the authorization of the Dormitory Authority of the State of New York ("DASNY"), as successor to the New York State Medical Care Facilities Finance Agency ("MCFFA") pursuant to the Health Care Financing Consolidation Act of 1995, to issue hospital and nursing home project bonds and notes from $20 billion to $21.8 billion.

sponsored.t: Relates to bonds and notes of the city of Yonkers
sponsored.sum: Extends certain provisions relating to bonds and notes of the city of Yonkers until June 30, 2027.

sponsored.t: Corrects a misclassification property tax error on behalf of Tanya Hairston
sponsored.sum: Corrects a misclassification property tax error on behalf of Tanya Hairston for the property located at 40 North Tenth Avenue in the city of Mount Vernon for the 2011 - 2020 city assessment tax rolls.

sponsored.t: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Yonkers
sponsored.sum: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Yonkers; repeals authorization of program December 31, 2031.

sponsored.t: Relates to the practice of natural hair care and braiding
sponsored.sum: Relates to the practice of natural hair care and braiding; creates an apprenticeship in such area; makes conforming technical changes.

sponsored.t: Prohibits approved providers of child health insurance coverage from discriminating against health care providers not participating in the insurer's network
sponsored.sum: Prohibits approved organizations providing coverage under the child health insurance plan from discriminating against health care providers which do not participate in the organization's health care network.

sponsored.t: Relates to personal income taxes in the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Extends certain provisions of law relating to tax rates and the imposition of income taxes in the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Relates to permitting the Asbury Methodist Church to file an application for a real property tax exemption
sponsored.sum: Relates to permitting the Asbury Methodist Church to file an application for a real property tax exemption.

sponsored.t: Relates to permitting the Westchester Muslim Center Inc. to file an application for a real property tax exemption
sponsored.sum: Relates to permitting the Westchester Muslim Center, Inc. to file an application for a real property tax exemption.

sponsored.t: Permits the city of Yonkers to establish a surcharge for vacant and abandoned property
sponsored.sum: Permits the city of Yonkers to establish a surcharge for up to 3 times the standard tax rate for vacant and abandoned property.

sponsored.t: Provides for emergency appropriation for the period April 1, 2026 through May 28, 2026
sponsored.sum: Provides for emergency appropriation through May 28, 2026 for the support of government.

sponsored.t: Designates certain entities relating to the decommissioning of Indian Point state agencies for the purposes of MWBE participation
sponsored.sum: Designates certain entities relating to the decommissioning of Indian Point state agencies for the purposes of MWBE participation including the Indian Point Decommissioning Oversight Board and the Indian Point Closure Task Force.

sponsored.t: Provides for emergency appropriation for the period April 1, 2026 through May 26, 2026
sponsored.sum: Provides for emergency appropriation through May 26, 2026 for the support of government.

sponsored.t: Provides for emergency appropriation for the period April 1, 2026 through May 20, 2026
sponsored.sum: Provides for emergency appropriation through May 20, 2026 for the support of government.

sponsored.t: Provides for emergency appropriation for the period April 1, 2026 through May 18, 2026
sponsored.sum: Provides for emergency appropriation through May 18, 2026 for the support of government.

sponsored.t: Provides for emergency appropriation for the period April 1, 2026 through May 14, 2026
sponsored.sum: Provides for emergency appropriation through May 14, 2026 for the support of government.

sponsored.t: Provides for emergency appropriation for the period April 1, 2026 through May 11, 2026
sponsored.sum: Provides for emergency appropriation through May 11, 2026 for the support of government.

sponsored.t: Provides for emergency appropriation for the period April 1, 2026 through May 6, 2026
sponsored.sum: Provides for emergency appropriation through May 6, 2026 for the support of government.

sponsored.t: Relates to the administration of certain funds and accounts related to the 2026-2027 budget, authorizing certain payments and transfers
sponsored.sum: Provides for the administration of certain funds and accounts related to the 2026-2027 budget, authorizing certain loans, payments and transfers.

sponsored.t: Provides for emergency appropriation for the period April 1, 2026 through May 4, 2026
sponsored.sum: Provides for emergency appropriation through May 4, 2026 for the support of government.

sponsored.t: Provides for the implementation of certain parts of the state fiscal plan for the 2026-2027 state fiscal year
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the South Country central school district, in the county of Suffolk, to issue serial bonds for the purpose of liquidating deficits in its general fund; requires that the district prepare quarterly budget reports, quarterly trial balances; provides for advance aid to such school district (Part A); extends provisions of law relating to directing the state inspector general to appoint an independent monitor for the Orange county industrial development agency for one year (Part B).

sponsored.t: Provides for emergency appropriation for the period April 1, 2026 through April 30, 2026
sponsored.sum: Provides for emergency appropriation through April 30, 2026 for the support of government.

sponsored.t: Provides for emergency appropriation for the period April 1, 2026 through April 27, 2026
sponsored.sum: Provides for emergency appropriation through April 27, 2026 for the support of government.

sponsored.t: Provides for emergency appropriation for the period April 1, 2026 through April 22, 2026
sponsored.sum: Provides for emergency appropriation through April 22, 2026 for the support of government.

sponsored.t: Provides for emergency appropriation for the period April 1, 2026 through April 20, 2026
sponsored.sum: Provides for emergency appropriation through April 20, 2026 for the support of government.

sponsored.t: Provides for emergency appropriation for the period April 1, 2026 through April 16, 2026
sponsored.sum: Provides for emergency appropriation through April 16, 2026 for the support of government.

sponsored.t: Provides for emergency appropriation for the period April 1, 2026 through April 14, 2026
sponsored.sum: Provides for emergency appropriation through April 14, 2026 for the support of government.

sponsored.t: Provides for emergency appropriation for the period April 1, 2026 through April 7, 2026
sponsored.sum: Provides for emergency appropriation through April 7, 2026 for the support of government.

sponsored.t: Extends provisions of law relating to certain costs of the department of motor vehicles
sponsored.sum: Extends provisions of law relating to increasing certain motor vehicle transaction fees and relating to certain costs of the department of motor vehicles.

sponsored.t: Requires each branch of state government and political subdivision of the state to establish and abide by a code of ethics
sponsored.sum: Requires each branch of state government and political subdivision of the state to establish and abide by a code of ethics; requires ethics commissions; sets standards for codes.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the governor from inserting policy into appropriations
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the governor from inserting policy into appropriations.

sponsored.t: Provides for funding for emergency management services for certain counties with non-operational nuclear power plants
sponsored.sum: Provides for funding for emergency management services for certain counties with non-operational nuclear power plants.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the power authority to create the New York State small business development program
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the power authority to create the New York State small business development program.

sponsored.t: Relates to the jurisdiction of a coroner or medical examiner
sponsored.sum: Provides that if it appears that a death may have resulted from the commission of a crime, the coroner or medical examiner in any county with geographic jurisdiction over the crime shall have concurrent jurisdiction and authority to investigate the death.

sponsored.t: Relates to leased vehicle protections
sponsored.sum: Relates to leased vehicle protections; provides that every lease shall itemize and set forth in detail all costs required to be paid by the lessee or purchaser of the rental vehicle upon termination of such lease.

sponsored.t: Requires forfeiture of vehicles for 6 months for second DWI offense and permanent forfeiture and registration denial for third DWI offense
sponsored.sum: Requires forfeiture of vehicles for six months for a second DWI offense and permanent forfeiture and registration denial for the third DWI offense; prohibits the issuance of a new license where there are two DWI convictions where physical injury has resulted from each offense.

sponsored.t: Authorizes a special account to create safe city streets, safe city, safe schools program in city of Yonkers
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the city of Yonkers to establish a separate fund into which revenue earmarked for the safe city streets, safe streets, safe schools program will be deposited.

sponsored.t: Designates ordinance officers of the city of Mount Vernon police department as peace officers
sponsored.sum: Designates ordinance officers of the city of Mount Vernon police department as peace officers; authorizes such officers to carry a firearm while performing duties as a peace officer if appropriate license has been issued therefor.

sponsored.t: Makes provisions with respect to student awards, loans and tuition assistance programs
sponsored.sum: Requires the higher education services corporation to make a determination of financial eligibility of a student for financial aid, awards and loans within 60 days from the day of the receipt of the financial aid application; where the higher education services corporation fails to make a timely determination the applicant shall be deemed eligible for such aid for the semester for which the application was made; allows for a 30-day extension if notice is given to the educational institution within the initial 60-day period.

sponsored.t: Decreases the prohibited area of parking around a fire hydrant from fifteen to ten feet
sponsored.sum: Decreases the prohibited area of parking around a fire hydrant from fifteen to ten feet to reduce parking congestion in heavily populated areas.

sponsored.t: Requires county clerks to designate one newspaper for the publication of judicial proceedings in the county
sponsored.sum: Requires county clerks to designate one newspaper or journal for the publication of every notice and advertisement of judicial proceedings in the county.

sponsored.t: Repeals and reenacts provisions on time limitations on certain actions against professional engineers, architects, other designers and construction contractors; repealer
sponsored.sum: Repeals and reenacts statute of limitation provisions on wrongful death, personal injury and property damage actions against professional engineers, architects, landscape architects, land surveyors, geologists and construction contractors to provide for a limitations period of ten years after completion of improvement to real property; "completion", which constitutes the accrual date for the limitations period, is defined; provides for a one year extension for injuries to person or property or wrongful death which occur during the tenth year after completion.

sponsored.t: Relates to reports of substantial risk or threat of harm by mental health professionals; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to reports of substantial risk or threat of harm by mental health professionals.

sponsored.t: Relates to nullifying agreements preventing dealers from purchasing from outside distributors
sponsored.sum: Nullifies agreements which prohibits a dealer, who either directly or through an affiliate owns a service station including the tanks and pumps or where a dealer provides environmental pollution insurance coverage for the tanks and pumps of not less than one million dollars in the aggregate and who dedicates a tank for sale of unbranded motor fuel, or any provision of a franchise with a refiner which prohibits a distributor from purchasing or selling unbranded motor fuel from a person or firm other than the refiner or limits the quantity of such unbranded motor fuel to be purchased from another person or firm or any provision of a franchise which directly or indirectly discourages a dealer…

sponsored.t: Relates to apportioning aid for career education in certain schools
sponsored.sum: Relates to apportioning aid for career in education in school districts located in a city with a population between 62,000 and 65,000 or between 67,000 and 70,000 as recorded in the 2010 census.

sponsored.t: Directs the superintendent of financial services to promulgate rules and regulations limiting the use of credit scores to determine automobile insurance premiums
sponsored.sum: Directs the superintendent of financial services to promulgate rules and regulations limiting the use of credit scores to determine automobile insurance premiums.

sponsored.t: Relates to the enactment of the New York State Excess Food Act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the New York state excess food act which provides for mandatory donation of consumable food products; provides mandatory composting of appropriate materials; establishes the New York state excess food fund which will be funded by fines collected from violations of the New York state excess food act.

sponsored.t: Relates to training and registration requirements for certain kidney dialysis patient care technicians
sponsored.sum: Establishes training and registration requirements for kidney dialysis patient care technicians; provides such training shall include clearly defined criteria for annual evaluations.

sponsored.t: Authorizes municipalities to establish an emergency repair pilot program
sponsored.sum: Establishes an office of special education services within the state education department to administer programs for children with disabilities to be headed by an assistant commissioner appointed by the board of regents.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain payment of prior year claims due to school districts
sponsored.sum: Provides that prior year claims due to school districts shall be paid out of any excess settlement amount recovered by the attorney general prior to being apportioned to the general fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to insurance loss prevention programs
sponsored.sum: Ensures that insurers are permitted to offer loss prevention programs as long as such programs are offered to the general public and the insurer's policyholders.

sponsored.t: Provides for the award of scholarships and loan forgiveness for dentists and podiatrists on the same terms as physicians
sponsored.sum: Provides for the award of regents scholarships and loan forgiveness for dentists and podiatrists on the same terms as physicians and dentists.

sponsored.t: Relates to reimbursement for ambulance services
sponsored.sum: Relates to reimbursement for ambulance services; requires insurers to submit payments directly to ambulance providers who are in-network or, for out-of-network ambulance providers, requires the issuance of a joint check to the insured specifying both the insured and the ambulance provider as payees.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing transparency in the retail prices of prescription drugs
sponsored.sum: Requires pharmacies to provide customers directly with the retail (before insurance) price of a prescription, in writing and electronically prior to purchase.

sponsored.t: Requires the commissioner of motor vehicles to install notification of the thirty foot requirement on every stop sign
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of motor vehicles to install notification of the thirty-foot requirement on every stop sign; ensures that the required distance established by the law will be posted on any stop sign to forewarn motorists upon approaching a stop sign.

sponsored.t: Relates to chemical testing for prospective foster parents
sponsored.sum: Relates to chemical testing for prospective foster parents; includes, but is not limited to drug and alcohol testing; authorizes office of children and family services to issue random chemical testing, including but not limited to, drug testing, to foster parents.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of motor vehicles, in conjunction with the office of court administration, to redesign uniform traffic tickets
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of motor vehicles, in conjunction with the office of court administration, shall redesign the uniform traffic tickets; such new design shall include, but not be limited, increasing the clarity of such ticket and providing clearly on the front of such ticket, the cancellation of the court appearance where a fine is paid prior to the date of such court appearance.

sponsored.t: Relates to creating the N.Y. State Health Care Consumer and Provider Protection and Equity Act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the NYS Health Care Consumer and Provider Protection and Equity Act to allow physicians and dentists to negotiate collectively with employers.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a housing part of the city court for the city of Yonkers
sponsored.sum: Establishes a housing part for city court of Yonkers to have jurisdiction of such actions and proceedings; including but not limited to enforcement and foreclosure of liens, injunctions and restraining orders for the enforcement of housing standards and special proceedings to vest title in the city of Yonkers to abandoned multiple dwellings; makes various other provisions.

sponsored.t: Permits the Church of Jesus Christ (Apostolic), Inc. to file an application for a real property tax exemption
sponsored.sum: Permits the Church of Jesus Christ (Apostolic), Inc., located at 332-340 South Columbus Avenue in the city of Mount Vernon, to file an application for a real property tax exemption.

sponsored.t: Authorizes licensed clinical social workers to provide services to injured employees under workers' compensation coverage
sponsored.sum: Authorizes licensed clinical social workers to provide services to injured employees under workers' compensation coverage; establishes special authorization shall be provided by the clinical social work practice committee.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting the sale of live genetically modified salmon
sponsored.sum: Relates to prohibiting the sale of live genetically modified salmon.

sponsored.t: Requires landlords to furnish each tenant either renewing or entering into a lease with a document describing the rights and duties of landlords and tenants
sponsored.sum: Requires landlords to furnish each tenant either renewing or entering into a lease with a rider describing the rights and duties of landlords and tenants; requires the rider to conform to the intent of section 5-702 of the general obligations law.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the denial of renewal of professional, business or trade licenses where a taxpayer has outstanding tax debt which the taxpayer has failed to settle
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the denial of the renewal of a license, permit, certificate, registration or admission to practice a profession, business or trade where a taxpayer has outstanding tax debt which the taxpayer has failed to enter into a settlement agreement for the payment thereof; requires each taxpayer renewing a license to practice a profession, business or trade to attest to the licensing agency that they do not have an unsettled outstanding tax debt.

sponsored.t: Relates to Tier 1 high tax aid apportionment and foundation aid
sponsored.sum: Relates to Tier 1 high tax aid apportionment and foundation aid.

sponsored.t: Provides for the time period bases and manner of payment of employment preparation education apportionment state aid
sponsored.sum: Provides for the time period bases and manner of payment of employment preparation education apportionment state aid.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the impoundment of vehicles operated by intoxicated or impaired persons
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the impoundment of vehicles operated by intoxicated or impaired persons; authorizes the release of impounded vehicles to owners of such vehicles if certain criteria is met; authorizes a reasonable fee for towing and storage of such vehicles.

sponsored.t: Enacts the health care consumer and provider protection act relating to collective negotiations by health care providers with certain health care plans
sponsored.sum: Enacts provisions relating to collective negotiations by health care providers with certain health care plans in certain counties; applies to health benefit plans that provide benefits for medical or surgical expenses incurred as a result of a health condition, accident or sickness, including an individual, group, blanket or franchise insurance policy or insurance agreement offered by certain enumerated entities.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the impoundment of any motor vehicle operated by a person who drives while ability impaired or intoxicated
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the impoundment of any motor vehicle operated by a person who drives while ability is impaired or intoxicated; provides for the imposition of towing and storage fees; provides for the release of impounded vehicles upon compliance with certain conditions.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the city of Yonkers to establish one or more transportation improvement districts
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the city of Yonkers to establish one or more transportation improvement districts to improve transportation in certain critical areas of the city.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring insurers insuring property in floodplains to include damages done by wave action or windblown waves
sponsored.sum: Requires insurers insuring property in floodplains to include damages done by wave action or windblown waves and make available to all insureds who reside in single family homes in a floodplain homeowners insurance covering such damage.

sponsored.t: Permits insurers to provide certain loss prevention and risk management devices to insureds and prospective insureds
sponsored.sum: Permits insurers to provide certain loss prevention and risk management electronics, equipment, devices or special offers to insureds and prospective insureds.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring a police officer or a district attorney to apply for a court order to compel a chemical test to determine blood alcohol content in certain cases
sponsored.sum: Requires court-ordered blood alcohol content testing for all drivers involved in fatal and serious physical injury accidents where there is a reasonable cause to believe an alcohol-related offense has been committed; provides exception when seeking court order would unduly interfere with emergency medical assistance or other necessary services at incident scene.

sponsored.t: Relates to capital apportionment to high need school districts bordering the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Provides the same adjustment for capital apportionment to high need school districts bordering the city of New York as used by school districts of the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Relates to the establishment of multi-year cost allowances for the Mount Vernon school district
sponsored.sum: Relates to the establishment of multi-year cost allowances for the Mount Vernon city school district.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing funding for transitional programs for students from English-speaking Caribbean countries
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing funding for transitional programs for students from English-speaking Caribbean countries who are not eligible for limited English proficiency programs.

sponsored.t: Bans open pickup trucks on the historic ten and one-half mile section of the Bronx River Parkway
sponsored.sum: Bans open pickup trucks on the historic ten and one-half mile section of the Bronx River Parkway, beginning in the city of Yonkers and the village of Bronxville where such Parkway diverges from the Sprain Brook Parkway and extends north along the Bronx River Parkway Reservation to the Kenisco Dam Plaza in the hamlet of Valhalla, town of Mt. Pleasant.

sponsored.t: Relates to disputes between a surrogate and a hospital or individual health care provider
sponsored.sum: Relates to disputes between a surrogate and a hospital or individual health care provider; cites when the requirement of a provider to provide life-sustaining treatment following a surrogate's directive does not apply.

sponsored.t: Precludes local criminal court from issuing a warrant of arrest based on any simplified information when the defendant has not been arraigned
sponsored.sum: Precludes a local criminal court from issuing a warrant of arrest based on any simplified information when the defendant has not been arraigned and has not come under the control of the court with respect to the charges in the simplified information; provides that this formerly applied only to simplified traffic information.

sponsored.t: Relates to compensation for information concerning fraudulent insurance transaction
sponsored.sum: Provides that any person who provides information to the attorney general, a district attorney or the insurance frauds bureau concerning a fraudulent insurance transaction or with information about a fraudulent insurance transaction that is about to take place may be entitled to an award of forty percent of the action or claim relating to such fraudulent action.

sponsored.t: Relates to excavation of underground facilities; expands the definition of "excavation" for the purposes of the protection of underground facilities
sponsored.sum: Expands the definition of "excavation" for the purposes of the protection of underground facilities.

sponsored.t: Relates to the appointment of commissioners of elections
sponsored.sum: Relates to the appointment of commissioners of elections; provides that once a party recommends a person for commissioner of elections the local legislative body shall automatically approve the appointment of such person.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring incarcerated individual sexual harassment complaints made against department employees to be investigated by the attorney general
sponsored.sum: Requires incarcerated individual sexual harassment complaints made against department employees to be investigated by the attorney general; makes the findings and recommendations of the attorney general final and binding on the part of the department.

sponsored.t: Eliminates the cap on the maximum amount and the gross income requirement for the long-term care insurance credit
sponsored.sum: Eliminates the $1500 cap on the maximum amount and the gross income requirement for the long-term care insurance credit.

sponsored.t: Designates the second Monday in July each year as a public holiday, to be known as Abolition Commemoration day
sponsored.sum: Designates the second Monday in July each year as a public holiday, to be known as Abolition Commemoration Day.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain brownfield redevelopment tax credits
sponsored.sum: Relates to certain qualifying property under brownfield redevelopment tax credits.

sponsored.t: Extends unfair labor practice protection to state grant recipients
sponsored.sum: Extends application of the NYS labor relations act and unfair labor practice protections to state grant recipients who act in the capacity of employers; permits a contracting state agency to cancel payments to a grant recipient upon a second or subsequent labor violation; defines "state grant recipient".

sponsored.t: Establishes family literacy programs for economically disadvantaged families living in poverty areas or areas with low-performing public schools
sponsored.sum: Establishes family literacy programs for economically disadvantaged families living in poverty areas or areas with low-performing public schools; provides for competitive matching grants to establish a comprehensive program; requires commissioner of education to submit an annual report to the governor and legislature.

sponsored.t: Authorizes a statewide toll free hotline run by the state police with reward for information leading to conviction of drunk drivers; imposes an additional surcharge on convicted drivers
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a statewide toll free hotline run by the state police with reward for reporting conduct of drivers leading to conviction of the crime of driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs; imposes an additional surcharge upon conviction of all criminally drunk or drugged drivers to fund expenses and rewards.

sponsored.t: Relates to the length of time that a person on a visa can hold a New York state driver's license or learner's permit
sponsored.sum: Relates to the length of time that a person on a visa can hold a New York state driver's license or learner's permit; provides that driver's license or learner's permit shall expire upon the expiration of a visa or upon the date the driver's license or learner's permit would normally expire whichever date first occurs.

sponsored.t: Provides for the licensing and regulation of the practice of neurofeedback therapy
sponsored.sum: Provides for the licensing and regulation of the practice of neurofeedback therapy; defines practice of neurofeedback therapy; establishes state board of neurofeedback therapy and the requirements to qualify for a license as a neurofeedback therapist.

sponsored.t: Relates to the practice of veterinary medicine
sponsored.sum: Excludes the use of equine pulsed electromagnetic field therapy from the practice of veterinary medicine.

sponsored.t: Relates to creating provisions regarding the unlawful sale of law enforcement identification
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale of any badge, shield, identification card or other insignia of any police department or law enforcement agency or a facsimile of such a badge or shield; imposes a civil penalty not to exceed $250 for each violation.

sponsored.t: Provides for the imposition of a fine for the failure of a cooperative apartment corporation to credit the STAR exemption to the tenant-stockholders thereof
sponsored.sum: Provides for the imposition of a fine for the failure of a cooperative apartment corporation to credit the STAR exemption to the tenant-stockholders thereof.

sponsored.t: Relates to creating a distinctive plate for New York state licensed mental health counselors
sponsored.sum: Creates a distinctive plate for New York state licensed mental health counselors.

sponsored.t: Provides for the issuance of distinctive "The Westchester Way" license plates for an additional $25 annual fee
sponsored.sum: Provides for the issuance of distinctive "The Westchester Way" license plates for an additional $25 annual fee; provides for the service charge collected to be credited to the department of motor vehicles distinctive plate development fund and the excess of six thousand dollars to be deposited in the "New York state 'The Westchester Way' fund" to be used to promote tourism in Westchester county; establishes the New York state "The Westchester Way fund" to administer such monies, which shall be made available to tourism promotion agencies.

sponsored.t: Requires businesses that purchase silver, gold and platinum to display current silver, gold and platinum prices
sponsored.sum: Requires businesses that purchase silver, gold and platinum to display current silver, gold and platinum prices.

sponsored.t: Entitles senior citizens to a refund of any security deposit exceeding one month's rent
sponsored.sum: Limits the amount of security deposit for residential rental premises which may be charged to a senior citizen who has occupied the premises for five years or more to the equivalent of one month's rent; entitles a person who has attained the age of sixty-two to a refund of that portion of any security deposit held by the landlord which exceeds one month's rent.

sponsored.t: Relates to repeat violators who endanger the public health, safety or the environment
sponsored.sum: Relates to repeat violators who endanger the public health, safety or the environment; increases penalties for such violators.

sponsored.t: Allows localities to exclude disability pension in determining eligibility level for partial exemption from real property tax
sponsored.sum: Allows localities the option to exclude income from any disability pension or benefit in computation of income for purposes of determining eligibility for the partial real property tax exemption granted to persons 65 years of age or over.

sponsored.t: Relates to permitting the Immanuel Evangelical Lutheran Church to file an application for a real property tax exemption
sponsored.sum: Relates to permitting the Immanuel Evangelical Lutheran Church to file an application for a real property tax exemption.

sponsored.t: Provides for the disposal of certain information or data maintained by agencies of government including electronic records
sponsored.sum: Provides for the disposal of certain information or data maintained by agencies of government including electronic records.

sponsored.t: Authorizes a public employee's contractual rights extended for six months beyond expiration date of current agreement for negotiation of new agreement
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a public employee's contractual rights be extended for up to six months beyond the expiration date of such employee's agreement for the sole purpose of negotiating a new agreement.

sponsored.t: Requires that bus drivers be provided with regular rest periods to have the opportunity to use a restroom
sponsored.sum: Requires that bus drivers be provided with regular rest periods to have the opportunity to use a restroom.

sponsored.t: Authorizes industrial development agencies to provide assistance to qualified residential facilities
sponsored.sum: Authorizes industrial development agencies to provide technical and financial assistance to qualified residential facilities; defines "qualified residential facility" as any multi-family residential facility with units that are for sale, in any municipality located within the county of Westchester, and which is located in an urban renewal area.

sponsored.t: Requires all individuals pawning goods to present identification and for pawnbrokers to keep records of such person
sponsored.sum: Requires all individuals pawning goods to present two forms of identification and for pawnbrokers to keep records of such person; requires pawnbrokers to report new goods within 24 hours of their receipt to the sheriff and they may not be sold or destroyed for 15 days; requires the sheriff to compile a list of goods stolen within the county.

sponsored.t: Provides for inclusion of the school district's regional cost index in calculating the supplemental education improvement plan grant amount for Yonkers city schools
sponsored.sum: Provides for inclusion of the school district's regional cost index in calculating the supplemental education improvement plan grant amount for Yonkers city school district.

sponsored.t: Requires that health services paid for by a school district for a student attending outside the district be no greater than the district's cost
sponsored.sum: Requires that health and welfare services and facilities paid by a school district for a student attending school outside the district be no greater than the district's cost.

sponsored.t: Prohibits political candidates from being nominated by more than one party for any public office
sponsored.sum: Prohibits political candidates from being nominated by more than one party for any public office.

sponsored.t: Relates to the handling fee paid to a dealer or operator of a redemption center for the redemption of empty beverage containers
sponsored.sum: Relates to the handling fee paid to a dealer or operator of a redemption center for the redemption of empty beverage containers.

sponsored.t: Excludes environmental contamination from consideration as a factor for real property assessment
sponsored.sum: Excludes environmental contamination from consideration as a factor for assessment.

sponsored.t: Requires insurance companies to issue joint checks for payment to an insured and a health care provider in certain circumstances
sponsored.sum: Requires insurance companies to issue joint checks for payment to an insured and a health care provider in certain circumstances.

sponsored.t: Limits certain regulations or orders promulgated by the superintendent related to term life insurance
sponsored.sum: Relates to term life insurance suitability information and the limiting of regulations or orders promulgated by the superintendent related thereto.

sponsored.t: Enacts the accessible electronic information act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the accessible electronic information act for blind and disabled persons; creates a new fund in the state finance law; authorizes a not-for-profit entity to administer the program.

sponsored.t: Requires passengers on school buses equipped with seat belts to wear such belts when the bus is in motion
sponsored.sum: Provides that all passengers of school buses must wear seat belts; exempts school bus attendants and others acting in a supervisory capacity from such requirement; requires that drivers announce "Everybody fasten your seat belts" before a school bus is placed in motion; empowers the commissioner of education to enforce such provisions; assigns a school bus attendant to each special needs student unable to comply with the seat belt requirement.

sponsored.t: Relates to the transparency and accountability of charter schools
sponsored.sum: Relates to charter schools; clarifies the transparency and accountability of charter schools and provides fiscal relief to the school districts where charter schools are located.

sponsored.t: Enacts the Child Sexual Abuse Reform Act; provides for the elimination and extension of certain statutes of limitations relating thereto
sponsored.sum: Enacts the Child Sexual Abuse Reform Act; provides for the elimination and extension of certain statutes of limitations related to sexual offenses against children, the expansion of reporting requirements in cases of such offenses, and the expansion of the central child abuse and maltreatment register.

sponsored.t: Grants the metropolitan transportation authority the power to suspend vehicle registration in certain cases
sponsored.sum: Grants the metropolitan transportation authority the power to suspend vehicle registration in certain cases.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring that genetically modified salmon that is sold or offered for sale be labeled
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring genetically modified salmon that is sold or offered for sale be labeled.

sponsored.t: Exempts low-emission and energy efficient vehicles from retail sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Exempts low-emission and energy efficient vehicles from retail sales and compensating use taxes.

sponsored.t: Relates to non-insurance benefits
sponsored.sum: Relates to authorizing non-insurance benefits or services to be offered as part of group life or group or blanket accident or health insurance policies.

sponsored.t: Allows Westchester county to require bidders for public works, construction or purchase contracts to hire and retain persons residing in certain targeted communities
sponsored.sum: Allows Westchester county to require bidders for public works, construction or purchase contracts to hire and retain persons residing in certain targeted communities based on the combined average poverty rate and unemployment rate.

sponsored.t: Relates to the terms of office of commissioners of elections
sponsored.sum: Increases the term of office of an election commissioner from two to four years beginning January first of each odd numbered year.

sponsored.t: Directs a health maintenance organization which denies a claim due to absence of medical necessity to advise insured as to alternative treatment
sponsored.sum: Directs a health maintenance organization which denies a claim due to absence of medical necessity to inform the insured as to preferred alternative treatment, or provide the insured with a statement as to the past ineffectiveness of the requested procedure or treatment.

sponsored.t: Relates to the rights of former outpatients of mental health facilities to have files sealed after ten years
sponsored.sum: Authorizes former outpatients of mental health facilities to request a court of competent jurisdiction to render an order to have their files sealed when more than ten years have elapsed since the last treatment in such facility, they are not currently being treated for mental illness and it would be in the best interests of the petitioner and society to seal such record without the requirement of a special proceeding.

sponsored.t: Reduces sales tax by one percent on vehicles manufactured in the United States
sponsored.sum: Reduces sales tax on vehicles manufactured in the United States by one percent; provides that the commissioner of taxation and finance shall obtain a listing of such vehicles from the commissioner of motor vehicles yearly.

sponsored.t: Prohibits discrimination in promotion of police officers who fail to meet their employer's ticket quotas
sponsored.sum: Prohibits discrimination in the promotion of police officers who fail to meet their employer's traffic ticket quota.

sponsored.t: Creates the Eastchester creek intermunicipal economic revitalization agency
sponsored.sum: Creates the Eastchester creek intermunicipal economic revitalization agency.

sponsored.t: Requires oil companies to clean up any spillage occurring during oil delivery
sponsored.sum: Requires oil companies to clean up any spillage occurring during oil delivery within 24 hours; imposes a fine of $500 for the first offense with $1000 for each additional offense.

sponsored.t: Designates the tenth day of March of each year as a public holiday, to be known as Harriet Tubman day
sponsored.sum: Designates the tenth day of March of each year as a public holiday, to be known as Harriet Tubman day.

sponsored.t: Requires certain health insurance policies to provide coverage for diagnostic testing for ovarian cancer
sponsored.sum: Provides that every health insurance policy which provides coverage for hospital, surgical or medical care shall provide coverage for the standard diagnostic testing for ovarian cancer upon the recommendation of a physician; provides that such standard diagnostic testing shall include a pelvic examination, a sonogram and a CA 125 blood test and related laboratory and diagnostic services.

sponsored.t: Requires certain health insurance policies and contracts to provide coverage for human leukocyte antigen testing for use in tissue typing for bone marrow testing
sponsored.sum: Requires certain health insurance policies and contracts to provide coverage for human leukocyte antigen testing, also referred to as histocompatible locus antigen testing, for A, B, and DR antigens, for utilization in tissue typing for bone marrow testing.

sponsored.t: Exempts from disclosure on the freedom of information law, the issuance of pistol permits to active and retired police officers, peace officers and correction officers
sponsored.sum: Exempts from disclosure, under the freedom of information law, the issuance of pistol permits to active and retired police officers, peace officers and correction officers.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing Yonkers city school district with additional supplemental education improvement plan funds
sponsored.sum: Provides Yonkers city school district with additional supplemental education improvement plan funds.

sponsored.t: Relates to operation of an authorized emergency vehicle
sponsored.sum: Relates to operation of an authorized emergency vehicle.

sponsored.t: Provides for the reestablishment of the Westchester parkway commission, to advise the commissioner of transportation
sponsored.sum: Provides for the reestablishment of the Westchester Parkway Commission, to advise the commissioner of transportation regarding the operation and maintenance of the special parkways within the county of Westchester.

sponsored.t: Permits an insurer to rescind or retroactively cancel a policy in circumstances involving an accident staged to defraud an insurer
sponsored.sum: Permits an insurer to rescind or retroactively cancel a policy in circumstances involving an accident staged to defraud an insurer.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the possession of certain antique rifles and their modern day replicas
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the possession of certain antique rifles and their modern day replicas.

sponsored.t: Relates to transportation management brokers
sponsored.sum: Relates to transportation management brokers; provides that transportation management brokers are no longer required to manage the transportation services for Medicaid beneficiaries.

sponsored.t: Relates to pharmacy benefit management services and durable medical equipment
sponsored.sum: Expands pharmacy benefit management services to include the management or administration of benefits relating to durable medical equipment; defines "durable medical equipment"; relates to pharmacy or durable medical equipment provider audits by pharmacy benefit managers.

sponsored.t: Criminalizes acting as a runner or soliciting or employing a runner to procure patients or clients
sponsored.sum: Criminalizes acting as a runner or soliciting or employing a runner to procure patients or clients.

sponsored.t: Sets forth additional conditions which may be available in an order of protection
sponsored.sum: Expands upon conditions which may be included in an order of protection issued for victims of domestic violence; makes other related alterations relative to the jurisdictions of supreme and family court in such situations; provides for payment of housing costs, compensation for incidental losses, possession of specified personal property, and prohibition of alienation of commonly held specified property.

sponsored.t: Increases the penalties for sexual performances by a child and provides for consecutive sentencing upon certain multiple convictions
sponsored.sum: Increases the penalties for sexual performances by a child; increases age from 16 to 18 for application of existing sexual performance crimes; creates crimes of use of a child in a sexual performance in the first degree, promoting an obscene sexual performance by a child in the first degree, and promoting a sexual performance by a child in the first degree; provides for consecutive sentencing upon certain multiple convictions.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring department of environmental conservation to establish guidelines for disqualification of stand-by contractors
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of environmental conservation to establish guidelines relating to the disqualification of contractors applying to perform stand-by contracts relating to past performance, reasonableness of pricing, acts of negligence and convictions for certain crimes reflecting on honesty, integrity and capability of any contractor.

sponsored.t: Relates to video lottery gaming located in Orange county
sponsored.sum: Relates to video lottery gaming located in Orange county.

sponsored.t: Conforms and improves the process for determining incapacity
sponsored.sum: Conforms and improves the process for determining incapacity.

sponsored.t: Relates to notice of disclaimer of liability for certain revived claims or causes of action
sponsored.sum: Relates to notice of disclaimer of liability for certain revived causes of action; such notice shall occur within 120 days after the insurer has received actual notice of such revived claim or cause of action.

sponsored.t: Creates the crime of prosecutorial misconduct
sponsored.sum: Provides that if a prosecutor withholds information proving the innocence of an individual convicted of or charged with a crime, such prosecutor shall be guilty of a felony with the term of imprisonment being twice that of the term of imprisonment the individual charged with the crime is faced with or twice that which the individual has been sentenced to.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring drivers approaching stationary emergency vehicles, tow or recovery trucks, or highway maintenance vehicles to switch lanes or reduce the speed of a motor vehicle
sponsored.sum: Requires a driver approaching stationary emergency vehicles, tow or recovery trucks, or highway maintenance vehicles displaying flashing lights to switch lanes or reduce the speed of the driver's vehicle, and be prepared to stop the vehicle; institutes a fine for failing to move over or slow down.

sponsored.t: Relates to transferring any unspent funds from the regents health care professional opportunity scholarship program to the regents physician loan forgiveness program
sponsored.sum: Transfers any unspent funds from the regents health care professional opportunity scholarship program to the regents physician loan forgiveness program; provides direction to distribute these funds to meet the same purposes as originally intended.

sponsored.t: Provides for designation of agency on aging in city of Yonkers
sponsored.sum: Allows chief executive officer of city of Yonkers to designate an agency on aging for purposes of county plans under community services for the elderly program (1965 federal older Americans act).

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing community colleges offering an associates degree program in nursing to offer a four-year bachelors degree program in nursing
sponsored.sum: Authorizes community colleges offering an associates degree program in nursing to offer a four-year bachelor degree program in nursing.

sponsored.t: Grants a special apportionment to certain school districts for certain public pension liabilities
sponsored.sum: Grants a special apportionment to school districts having a population of between 195,000 and 219,000, for additional expenses incurred in the 2023-2024 and 2024-2025 school years associated with changes in public pension liabilities.

sponsored.t: Relates to the governance of the Westchester county health care corporation
sponsored.sum: Relates to the governance of the Westchester county health care corporation to twenty-one voting directors and provides for the appointment of such members.

sponsored.t: Requires the state police to investigate accusations of police misconduct
sponsored.sum: Requires the superintendent of state police to investigate accusations of police misconduct filed against town or village police.

sponsored.t: Requires communities with traffic-control devices with photo monitoring to have uniform duration periods for all yellow signal lights on any traffic-control devices
sponsored.sum: Requires that in communities which include traffic-control devices outfitted with photo monitoring instruments, amber or yellow signal lights located on any traffic-control device in such community shall have uniform duration periods.

sponsored.t: Makes provisions with respect to affordable housing within the city of Yonkers
sponsored.sum: Makes provisions with respect to affordable housing within the city of Yonkers; provides funds of twenty-five thousand dollars in the affordable housing development account for new construction of affordable housing within the city of Yonkers and acquisition of existing housing stock cooperatives, condominiums and fee simple multi-family housing where appropriate.

sponsored.t: Establishes crime of aggravated criminal conduct
sponsored.sum: Establishes crime of aggravated criminal conduct to provide more severe penalties for persons who have committed 3 or more qualifying misdemeanors or felonies within ten years of the present class A misdemeanor offense.

sponsored.t: Relates to real property tax lien transfers; repealer
sponsored.sum: Establishes provisions for real property tax lien transfers to assist homeowners facing foreclosure based on unpaid taxes; repeals existing provisions relating to acceptance of taxes from certain loan corporations.

sponsored.t: Directs the state comptroller to implement the federal authorization to encourage the use of mass transportation
sponsored.sum: Directs the state comptroller to implement the federal authorization to encourage the use of mass transportation by state employees.

sponsored.t: Directs the discontinuance of the Yonkers toll plaza on the New York state thruway
sponsored.sum: Directs the New York state thruway authority to discontinue and remove the Yonkers toll plaza on the New York state thruway.

sponsored.t: Modifies provisions for the payment of delinquent taxes by permitting any person or entity to lend money to the taxpayer and pay the taxing jurisdiction; repealer
sponsored.sum: Modifies provisions for the payment of delinquent taxes by permitting any person or entity to lend the money to the property owner therefor, with the lender to pay the taxing jurisdiction and receive a conditional tax receipt; requires recording of tax liens; provides for foreclosure of a conditional tax receipt like a mortgage.

sponsored.t: Provides reimbursement to licensed not-for-profit corporations providing the office for people with developmental disabilities services for retirement cost
sponsored.sum: Provides for the annual reimbursement to licensed not-for-profit corporations which provide direct care to consumers approved for service by the office for people with developmental disabilities for the cost of employer contributions to a retirement benefit fund governed by the provisions of the Federal Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the establishment of a public library revolving loan fund
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the establishment of a public library revolving loan fund to provide loans to municipalities for local public library projects at an interest rate two points below the prime rate.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the erection or maintenance of billboards advertising alcoholic beverages within 1000 feet of schools or playgrounds
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the erection or maintenance of billboards advertising alcoholic beverages within 1000 feet of schools or playgrounds; defines "billboard".

sponsored.t: Provides for establishing a demonstration program implementing a dual track child protective program in Westchester county
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "Westchester county dual track demonstration program"; provides for establishing a demonstration program implementing a dual track child protective program in Westchester county; provides that such program shall be supervised by the office of children and family services; provides for the appointment of an advisory council and for various evaluations of the program; requires reports thereon.

sponsored.t: Enacts the omnibus telecommunications reform act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "omnibus telecommunications reform act"; reforms the competitive cable service; promotes the wide-spread development of high-capacity broadband internet access; increases the availability and quality of services in this key economic development area; ensures the safety, reliability and affordability of telecommunications services.

sponsored.t: Prohibits banks from holding for deposit state issued check
sponsored.sum: Prohibits banks from holding for deposit the funds from checks issued by the state.

sponsored.t: Authorizes state and municipal agencies to regulate use of geographic information systems materials after the disclosure thereof under freedom of information law
sponsored.sum: Authorizes state and municipal agencies to establish rules and regulations for the use, distribution, duplication, sale and resale of geographic information systems materials disclosed under the freedom of information law; authorizes the imposition of fees for copies of such materials which do not exceed the fair market value of the materials; establishes such rules and regulations shall be consistent with those adopted by the committee on open government; authorizes applicants to appeal the reasonableness of any fees imposed therefor.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the commissioner of education to appoint a monitor to oversee the Mount Vernon city school district; repealer
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the commissioner of education to appoint a monitor to oversee the Mount Vernon city school district; establishes the powers and duties of such monitor.

sponsored.t: Expands eligibility for designation as land used in agricultural production
sponsored.sum: Expands eligibility for designation as land used in agricultural production by lowering the average gross sale value of the land to $20,000 or more in certain cases.

sponsored.t: Enacts provisions providing protection to employees from retaliatory actions by employers where such employees report improper business activities
sponsored.sum: Enacts provisions providing protection to employees from retaliatory actions by employers where such employees report improper business activities; applicable to employees who in good faith reasonably believe that an improper business activity has or will occur, based on information that the employees reasonably believe to be true; provides remedies and relief.

sponsored.t: Provides for accelerated payments to the city school district of the city of Mount Vernon
sponsored.sum: Provides for accelerated payments to the city school district of the city of Mount Vernon.

sponsored.t: Excludes certain training stipends for volunteer firefighters from state income tax
sponsored.sum: Excludes certain training stipends for volunteer firefighters from state income tax.

sponsored.t: Limits the sale of chemical hair relaxers and permanent hairstyle kits
sponsored.sum: Limits the sale of chemical hair relaxers and permanent hairstyle kits to licensed cosmetologists.

sponsored.t: Equips all ambulances and emergency ambulance service vehicles with stop-arms
sponsored.sum: Equips all ambulances and emergency ambulance service vehicles with stop-arms; provides rules and regulations shall be promulgated to provide for such equipment.

sponsored.t: Provides for emergency appropriation for the period April 1, 2025 through May 9, 2025
sponsored.sum: Provides for emergency appropriation through May 9, 2025 for the support of government.

sponsored.t: Designates a portion of the state highway system as the "Dwight Heavy D Myers Way"
sponsored.sum: Designates state route 22 between Lorraine Avenue and Lincoln Avenue in the city of Mount Vernon as the "Dwight 'Heavy D' Myers Way".

sponsored.t: Requires certain joint tax returns pertaining to residential real estate cash purchases by limited liability companies to disclose the source of funds used for the purchase
sponsored.sum: Requires certain joint tax returns pertaining to residential real estate cash purchases by limited liability companies to be accompanied by a document which identifies the source or sources of funds used for the purchase, including the type of funding used, the bank account information of any funds used in the purchase and the amount used by each source of funds.

sponsored.t: Requires victims of firearm violence be offered and/or provided psychiatric care
sponsored.sum: Requires victims of firearm violence be offered and/or provided psychiatric care.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the cultivation, processing, distribution and sale of edible cannabis products, flavored cannabis vape cartridges, and other flavored cannabis products, and restricts cannabis labeling and advertisement
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the cultivation, processing, distribution and sale of edible cannabis products, flavored cannabis vape cartridges and other flavored cannabis products; prohibits the use of food-related names in the labeling or packaging of cannabis products; prohibits the use of food-related names in the advertisement of cannabis products.

sponsored.t: Authorizes counties with a population of one million or more persons to use the alternative delivery method known as design-build contracts
sponsored.sum: Authorizes counties with a population of one million or more persons to undertake certain public works pursuant to project labor agreements; authorizes the use of the alternative delivery method known as design-build contracts; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Relates to the notice required for the termination of temporary payments of compensation and the notice required for cessation of compensation payments
sponsored.sum: Relates to notice requirements for the termination of temporary workers' compensation payments and cessation of compensation payments.

sponsored.t: Prohibits local boards of elections from purchasing direct recording electronic machines
sponsored.sum: Prohibits local boards of elections from purchasing direct recording electronic machines; requires local boards of elections to provide hand marking and ballot marking device options at all polling places.

sponsored.t: Increases the tax on deeds in the city of Mount Vernon
sponsored.sum: Increases the tax on deeds in the city of Mount Vernon to 1 1/2 percent.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the city of Mount Vernon to impose a hotel and motel tax
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the city of Mount Vernon to impose a hotel and motel tax of 5.875%.

sponsored.t: Extends the expiration date of the personal income tax surcharge imposed in the city of Yonkers
sponsored.sum: Extends the expiration date of the personal income tax surcharge imposed by the city of Yonkers.

sponsored.t: Extends certain provisions relating to additional sales tax imposed by the city of Yonkers
sponsored.sum: Extends certain provisions relating to additional sales tax imposed by the city of Yonkers.

sponsored.t: Extends the expiration of the mortgage recording tax imposed by the city of Yonkers
sponsored.sum: Extends the expiration of the mortgage recording tax imposed by the city of Yonkers.

sponsored.t: Relates to bonds and notes of the city of Yonkers
sponsored.sum: Extends certain provisions relating to bonds and notes of the city of Yonkers until June 30, 2026.

sponsored.t: Modernizes the practice of podiatry
sponsored.sum: Modernizes the practice of podiatry specifically relating to ankle surgery.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the city of Mt. Vernon to establish a school speed zone demonstration program
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the city of Mt. Vernon to establish a school speed zone demonstration program; authorizes installation in no more than twenty school speed zones in such city.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "City of Dunkirk Revenue Anticipation Note Refinancing Act"; makes an appropriation therefor
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "City of Dunkirk Revenue Anticipation Note Refinancing Act" to authorize a loan to be made from the state to the city of Dunkirk (Part A); makes an appropriation therefor (Part B).

sponsored.t: Provides for amendments to a tribal-state compact with the Seneca Nation of Indians
sponsored.sum: Provides for amendments to a tribal-state compact with the Seneca Nation of Indians.

sponsored.t: Authorizes a court to direct filing of non-family offense order of protection with the computerized registry for such orders and warrants
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a court issuing a non-family offense temporary order of protection or an order of protection to direct that such order be filed with the computerized registry for orders of protection and warrants, if it is necessary to fulfill the purposes of such order; directs the superintendent of state police to include such orders on computerized registry.

sponsored.t: Provides for emergency appropriation for the period April 1, 2025 through May 7, 2025
sponsored.sum: Provides for emergency appropriation through May 7, 2025 for the support of government.

sponsored.sum: Provides for emergency appropriation through May 7, 2025 for the support of government.

sponsored.sum: Provides for emergency appropriation through May 1, 2025 for the support of government.

sponsored.sum: Provides for emergency appropriation through April 29, 2025 for the support of government.

sponsored.sum: Provides for emergency appropriation through April 24, 2025 for the support of government.

sponsored.sum: Provides for emergency appropriation through April 3, 2025 for the support of government.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the state comptroller to refund all or any part of bonds
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the state comptroller to refund all or any part of bonds when it is to the advantage of the state.

sponsored.t: Defines medically fragile young adults for certain purposes
sponsored.sum: Defines medically fragile young adults as individuals who meet the definition of children with medical fragility, but for the fact such individuals are aged between twenty-one and thirty-five years old.
